name: Clear Inclusion Match (EGFR+ NSCLC Stage IV)
description: Patient meets all inclusion criteria and triggers zero exclusions.

patient.clinical_summary: 58-year-old female diagnosed with metastatic Stage IV lung adenocarcinoma with documented EGFR exon 19 deletion. ECOG performance status 1. Platelets 210k/uL, ANC 2.8k/uL, creatinine 0.9 mg/dL. Brain MRI negative for intracranial disease. No prior 3rd generation EGFR-TKI exposure.

trial.title: Study of Osimertinib vs Standard of Care EGFR-TKI as First-Line Treatment in Patients With EGFR-Mutated NSCLC

criteria.text: Age >= 18 years at screening.
Histologically or cytologically confirmed Stage IV Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer.
Documented activating EGFR mutation (Exon 19 deletion or L858R).
ECOG performance status 0 or 1.
Platelet count >= 100,000/uL.
Prior treatment with any third-generation EGFR-TKI (e.g., Osimertinib, Lazertinib).
Active or symptomatic central nervous system (CNS) metastases.

rationale: All inclusion criteria met and all exclusion criteria absent.

name: Clear Exclusion Conflict (Prior 3rd Gen TKI)
description: High semantic similarity but hard exclusion triggered due to prior Osimertinib therapy.

patient.clinical_summary: 64-year-old male with Stage IV NSCLC, previously treated with Osimertinib 80mg daily with progression. ECOG 1. Normal laboratory function.

conditions: Congestive Heart Failure NYHA Class III

criteria.text: ECOG performance status 0 or 1.

name: Compound Criteria Logic (Platelet Failure in Hematologic Panel)
description: Compound AND/OR criteria where ANC is acceptable but platelets fail threshold.

patient.clinical_summary: 63-year-old male with EGFR L858R NSCLC. ANC is 2,100/uL, but platelets are depressed at 82,000/uL (below required 100,000/uL threshold).

criteria.text: Adequate bone marrow reserve: ANC >= 1,500/uL AND Platelets >= 100,000/uL AND Hemoglobin >= 9.0 g/dL.

rationale: Platelet count of 82,000/uL violates the 100,000/uL bone marrow adequacy threshold.

name: Ambiguous Subjective Criteria (Physician Adjudication Required)
description: Protocol requires adequate cardiac reserve in the opinion of the investigator; patient has borderline QTc.

patient.clinical_summary: 65-year-old male with Stage IV NSCLC, EGFR L858R. Baseline ECG demonstrates borderline corrected QT interval of 462 ms. Asymptomatic.

trial.title: Study of Osimertinib in EGFR-Mutated NSCLC

criteria.text: Mean resting corrected QT interval (QTcF) > 470 ms or history of clinically significant arrhythmia in the opinion of the investigator.

rationale: QTc of 462 ms is below the hard threshold of 470 ms, but clinical history of borderline prolongation requires investigator assessment.
